The path instructions require the explicit `.ts` extension. Under Node type stripping, an extensionless specifier does not resolve. `bun build` currently masks this. The neighbouring `./dshgo-copy` import has the same problem. Fix both.
Proposed fix
```diff --- "a/packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/dshgo-views.ts" +++ "b/packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/dshgo-views.ts" @@ -39,7 +39,7 @@ type DshGoView, } from "../../mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/dshgo-view.ts" import { copyFor, type DshGoCopy } from "./dshgo-copy" -import { graphLinesOf, graphNeedsFold, graphStepsOf, layerGraphOf } from "./dshgo-graph" +import { graphLinesOf, graphNeedsFold, graphStepsOf, layerGraphOf } from "./dshgo-graph.ts" import type { PanelSnapshot } from "./dshgo-panel" /** One task row of the team board, as the team panel renders it. */ ```
As per path instructions: "Every relative specifier carries the explicit `.ts` extension".

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion import { graphLinesOf, graphNeedsFold, graphStepsOf, layerGraphOf } from "./dshgo-graph.ts" ```

+// disposer, never a throw, and its plugin face exposes no read-back (`getSnapshot` is host-only).

+// what IS verified here is that `register` was callable and did not throw.

body:
** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Pass the injected scope to the theme registry.** When the adapter binds `tuiThemes`, its callback supplies the service’s injected scope. This callback discards that scope and passes the outer `ctx` to `register`. The v0.18.0 host rejects an identity from another activation with an inert disposer. The code then reports `requested`, although the theme is unavailable in the picker. Use the callback’s scope for both `register` and `effectOn`, and make the test double check that identity. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaroldZ32/My-Power-Dsh/7296ef8898a44f2f79991a86786f6148244b6e5d/packages/mpd-tui-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts))
Proposed registration change
```diff - tui.whenBound("themes", (service) => { + tui.whenBound("themes", (service, scope) => { ... - const disposer = registry.register(MPD_THEME, ctx) - if (typeof disposer === "function") effectOn(ctx, disposer, `mpd-tui theme ${MPD_THEME.name}`) + const disposer = registry.register(MPD_THEME, scope) + if (typeof disposer === "function") effectOn(scope, disposer, `mpd-tui theme ${MPD_THEME.name}`) ```
Also applies to: 72-73
